stemMarkdown: In a race of 250 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 9:5. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 250 m, B covers $\dfrac{5}{9} \times 250 = 138.89$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 250 - 138.89 = 111.11$ m.
